planned_preserve_tables.reason: Authenticated command-denial observations are security audit records; the purge role has no DELETE grant. Migration 0010 creates this table, which is explicitly preserved outside the purge allowlist.
Authentication sessions are security state and are not tenant business data; session expiration/revocation is owned by REM-WP5.3, not the test-data purge operation.
The UUID-to-tenant lookup index is maintained by a database trigger and is private control-plane routing metadata, not test-owned business data.
HMAC-keyed account/source attempt history is cross-tenant security control state with a fixed 15-minute retention window and remains outside the purge allowlist.

Root migration 0006 links requirement_sources to global requirement_definitions and legal_sources; it has no organization or tenant ownership path and is preserved with the restricted global catalogue.

audit_ledger.status: future REM-WP4.2 control-plane table; never in delete allowlist; purge role cannot update/delete prior audit rows

execution_constraints: Use individual DELETE statements in one transaction; no TRUNCATE, CASCADE, DROP SCHEMA, dynamic all-table discovery, or broad grant.
Capture IDs of organizations belonging to test tenants before deleting parent/tenant rows; use that frozen set for organization-scoped control-plane row predicates.
Require exact migration inventory match; any new table without an explicit preserve/delete row policy fails before SQL.
Write successful audit row in the same transaction as purge and deterministic reseed.
Refusal audit must not mutate the target before the target is independently verified.
This candidate list must be reviewed against current migration SQL and foreign-key graph before REM-WP0.5 can pass.

purge_role_contract.name: symphony_phase1_purger
purge_role_contract.ownership: not owner of schema, tenant tables, or audit ledger
purge_role_contract.sql_grants: DELETE only for explicit allowlist; narrowly scoped SELECT required to verify target/marker/organization IDs; INSERT only for deterministic seed and success audit
purge_role_contract.forbidden: No DDL, no unrestricted DELETE, no UPDATE/DELETE on audit ledger, no production endpoint/credential, no app-role inheritance
